justification: Both depict an animal or animal-like creature rendered with incised linear detail and some hatched or patterned infill, but that is the extent of the correspondence. A shows a three-dimensional head/upper body with a face, deep-set eyes and a cross-hatched mane or garment, while B shows a flat, framed panel with a striding quadruped in profile within a bordered rectangle — different formats, postures, relationships and compositional schemes entirely.
